name: Fujiwara BitterSweet
source:
Aya just moved to a new little town near the mountains. Her new life as a high school freshman begins now, join her as she navigates through life and meets new people. Will she make friends or perhaps… find herself falling in love?

[From [url=https://magicbench.itch.io/fujibittersweet-full]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿雅刚刚搬到靠近山脉的一个新小镇。她作为高中新生的新生活现在开始了，和她一起度过人生并结识新朋友。她会交到朋友还是……发现自己坠入爱河？

[来自[url=https://magicbench.itch.io/fujibittersweet-full]itch.io[/url]]
